name: game-prd-web
title_zh: 8 个游戏策划技能打包，从立项到验收各管一段
tagline_zh: 不是零散提示词，是 8 个分工明确的技能。覆盖玩法设计、数值、文案、测试，装完就能在游戏项目里分段调用。
tagline_en: Not loose prompts but 8 role-specific skills for game design, numbers, copy, testing. Install and call per stage.
why_zh: 按游戏研发流程切分，每段技能只干自己那件事，边界清楚，不会一个提示词从头管到尾导致失控。
why_en: Cut along the real dev pipeline, each skill owns one narrow job. Clean boundaries beat one mega-prompt that drifts.
limit_zh: 只覆盖网页端游戏 PRD 写作相关环节，不含美术、音频、运营向技能；每个技能独立生效，不提供跨技能自动串联。
limit_en: Web-game PRD writing only. No art, audio, or live-ops skills. Each works standalone; no auto-chaining across skills.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: 8 game PRD skills: from concept to acceptance, each covers.
